description: This file contains utility functions for Kubernetes resource generation, including creating base nodes, validating data maps, copying labels and annotations, setting immutability, and parsing file sources within the kustomize tool.

methods.name: makeBaseNode
methods.description: Creates a YAML node with specified kind, name, and namespace, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: makeValidatedDataMap
methods.description: Loads key-value pairs from a loader, validates keys, and returns a map of known keys.

methods.name: copyLabelsAndAnnotations
methods.description: Copies labels and annotations from GeneratorOptions into a YAML node.

methods.name: setImmutable
methods.description: Sets the 'immutable' field on a YAML node if specified in options.

methods.name: ParseFileSource
methods.description: Parses a source string into a key name and file path, handling different formats and errors.
